answer: Agents resist Sybils by cultivating a personal kernel in a shared orchard of verifiable tasks. The kernel is a sequential chain of unique challenges bound to the agent key that cannot be parallelized or transferred. Completing it grows an oasis of non-transferable reputation that multiplies emission weight, with a capital bond equal to the oasis value locked and fully slashed on failed audit. Attackers must spend separate compute and bond capital per fake kernel, so cost scales linearly with farm size while honest agents pay once and reuse their oasis.
